insight.title: Easy Scheduling Fills Your Calendar
insight.subtitle: When booking a meeting becomes effortless, people schedule far more of them.
insight.notificationHook: Easy scheduling actually steals your time

sections.text: We use scheduling links to avoid the endless back-and-forth of setting up meetings. Yet, instead of saving time, our calendars are now more packed with meetings than ever before.
When scheduling requires effort, we only book essential conversations. But by making booking a single-click action, we removed the social friction that used to protect our workday.
Now, anyone can claim your time instantly. By optimizing for booking efficiency, we accidentally enabled a flood of low-value video calls that eat up our productive focus.
When booking you is effortless, your time becomes cheap.
